senses.gloss: f. (חזז to make incisions) lichen, a cutaneous disease connected with desquamation and sometimes ulceration.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 6:12">Bekh. VI, 12</cite> <he>בעל ח׳</he> an animal afflicted with lichen.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 41a:7">Ib. 41ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="J00399"><he>ילפת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 22:22">Lev. XXII, 22</cite>) <he>ח׳ המצרית</he> Egyptian lichen; <he>ח׳ דעלמא</he> ordinary lichen.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:6">Succ. III, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Sukkah 34b:9">34ᵇ</cite>) <he>עלתה ח׳</he> if an Ethrog is covered with lichen (scabs).

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:1">Ruth R. to III, 8</cite> (ref. to <he>וילפת</he> <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 6:1">ib.</cite>, a. <cite ref="J00399"><he>יַלֶּפֶת</he></cite>) <he>לפפתו</he> (<he>לפתתו</he>) <he>כח׳</he> she twisted herself around him like lichen.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:5:4">Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ</cite> top <he>רוח ח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00346"><he>תְּזָזִית</he></cite>.]
